source_documents.title: Encodable Bracket-Size / Group-Format Logic for Multi-Flight Youth Soccer Tournaments
source_documents.note: The document's VERIFIED labels are source claims, not verification performed by MatchBalance.

recommendation_policies.description: Prefer fewer competitive flights when every required projected matchup meets the competitive limits.
selection_steps: Require a structurally valid plan with complete required predictions and no projected matchup violations.
Then prefer the lower worst matchup cost.
Then prefer the lower pair-weighted average matchup cost.
Use deterministic boundary and template ordering for numerical ties.

templates.advancement_description: The group winner and runner-up advance to one final.
operational_requirements: An event requiring at least three games for every team must not use this variant because the non-finalist receives two games.
templates.source_section: US Youth Soccer Presidents Cup - 3 teams

templates.advancement_description: The group winner and runner-up advance to one final.

templates.advancement_description: Champion and finalist are determined by final standings; no separate playoff is played.
operational_requirements: The event must accept a standings-only championship for this flight.
templates.source_section: US Youth Soccer Presidents Cup - 5 teams

templates.advancement_description: The four highest point totals across the crossover advance to semifinals, seeded first versus fourth and second versus third.
operational_requirements: Each team must be able to play all three teams in the opposite pool before the semifinals.
templates.source_section: US Youth Soccer Presidents Cup - 6 teams

templates.advancement_description: Both group winners and two wildcards advance to semifinals.
unequal_pool_requirements: Average points must be used when comparing teams that played only two group games with teams that played three.

templates.advancement_description: Each pool winner and runner-up advances to cross-pool semifinals.

templates.advancement_description: The four-team pool winner and the three highest point totals from the two three-team crossover pools advance to semifinals.
